package: K35-T2 recover multipart upload after DB rollback following storage commit

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 after all 84 Prisma migrations; container stopped after test
result.injected_failure: A temporary one-shot PostgreSQL trigger raises inside the UPLOADING -> READY transaction after the loopback S3-compatible server has completed multipart and stored the valid object.
assertions: first Studio complete returns HTTP 500 when promotion transaction fails
transaction rollback leaves original UPLOADING, retains uploadId, and creates no encode job
the completed original object remains present in storage
retry receives NoSuchUpload, verifies existing bytes, promotes original to READY and creates a job
the real scripts/video-worker.ts processes the recovered original to SUCCEEDED

limitations: Failure injection targets the disposable PostgreSQL promotion transaction after the storage operation; it does not kill a process or sever a real R2 network connection.
Storage and worker use the loopback S3-shaped fixture; no Cloudflare R2 or deployed Worker was contacted.
This is one recovery boundary, not the complete K35 role/state/payment matrix or independent review.
